title: Symbol-value encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, and let $\mathrm{Ans}$ assign a Boolean value to each selector and pair of natural numbers. For an optional tape position $\tau$, a Boolean sign $s$, and natural numbers $t,a$, define the encoded symbol value to be absent if the answer for sign $\mathrm{true}$ is true, and otherwise to be the answer for sign $\mathrm{false}$ at $(\tau,t,a)$.
hypotheses_covered: answer function on selectors and pairs of natural numbers
